g.data-port-groups: 5 groups of 4 (1 x QSFP-DD + 3 x QSFP28)
g.title: a9903-20hg-pec

circle.data-description: the OIR READY lamp, printed beside STATUS. No colour table for either lamp is in the intake - the fixed-port guide's PEC sections cover installation and port modes and give no LED table - so OIR READY carries off/on and STATUS carries the four-state card vocabulary the modular line cards use, which is a borrowing and is said so here.
